name: SHESHA

variants.depicted: Shesha the Hindu divine naga, in the exactly FIVE-hood iconographic form, unfolding above a great coiled body in cosmic space.
variants.anatomy: ONE divine serpent with ONE continuous limbless coiled body and exactly FIVE separate cobra necks, each ending in exactly ONE hooded cobra head. Total FIVE heads, FIVE hoods, TEN eyes; no sixth head, no central hidden head, no human torso, arms, legs, crown or horns. Arrange the heads as a clean fan: left outer, left inner, CENTRE, right inner, right outer, all individually separated with dark gaps and fully visible faces. Each head is noble, composed and dignified rather than snarling. [sesa-c01, sesa-c05]
variants.moment: Unfold the five hooded heads upward from the mighty coil, hoods expanding physically, outer two necks arc forward toward the viewer while center head rises above them. A reverent active manifestation of the king of serpents, faces intent and unmistakable.
variants.power: No documented supernatural visual effect. Sacred grandeur arises from the FIVE real cobra heads unfolding above the physical coiled serpent body floating through cosmic space, the documented iconographic setting. No glow aura, beams, flames, runes, storms or water control. [sesa-c01, sesa-c05]
variants.setting: Dark cosmic space around the large coiled serpent, explicitly in the accepted c05 quotation; sparse tiny distant stars are editorial backdrop, not glowing magic. No Vishnu or Lakshmi added, keeping all FIVE faces the sole subject. [sesa-c05]
variants.camera: Extreme low-angle tight frontal five-head fan portrait, all FIVE head faces occupy the upper two-thirds with their distinct hood edges, thick coil sweeps across bottom. Each cobra face large and readable at 200px; symmetrical overall with living neck curvature, no other creature.
variants.light: One distant warm celestial light from the upper side gives antique-gold rim along dark bronze scales, deep low-key cosmic darkness. No emitted light from serpent.

requirements.description: Exact five-hood iconographic Shesha: one coiled limbless serpent body, five necks/heads/hoods, ten eyes.
No supernatural power effect: physical unfolding of heads and documented floating coiled form only.
Cosmic space explicitly named in accepted c05 quote; no unresearched beings or light aura.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
